summary: Email connector for automation graphs (pkg/automation/connectors/email): kinds smtp and imap; email.send, email.wait_reply and email.label nodes; the email.received.v1 trigger polled over IMAP (UIDVALIDITY cursor, dedup by Message-ID, attachments stored in uploads, skip_replies and skip_auto); a reply is found by its References and In-Reply-To headers; login and password for any server, OAuth2 sign-in with SASL XOAUTH2 for Gmail and Microsoft 365 (one sign-in makes both connections); the application's SMTP_* as a platform credential; a fake SMTP/IMAP server in emailtest. connectors gain OAuth2Presets, OAuth2Finisher and PresetOAuth2; engine.InboundPoller also polls the connections of an enabled graph's wait nodes; graph templates and values may name list items (items[].field). IntegrationsService.OAuthStartPreset saves the sign-in's connections together; the SMTP_* credential is wired into the module's platform credentials; attachments are private and served by /automations/attachments/{id}; engine.Baseliner keeps the cursor of an idle mailbox.
